Seems weird when you look at the comic book sales.

Yeah, Image is putting out some fantastic books, and Dark Horse is making a splash with unique story lines, but those companies don't have movie tie-ins.

DC Comics has been dominating. Not 'barely winning', but destroying the competition when it comes to sales. Not saying their opinion is wrong, but I don't see it when looking at the data.
